# Solana Icons — full reference

Open-source icon library for Solana projects. Free SVG and PNG downloads. MIT license. Canonical host **https://icons.sol.new** (Cloudflare Workers only).

## Product

- Canonical: https://icons.sol.new
- Worker: `solana-icons` · https://solana-icons.gm-4e8.workers.dev
- Package: npm `solana-icons`
- Repo: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons
- ~567 unique icons · 11 categories

| Phantom | `/svg/wallets/phantom.svg` |
| Solflare | `/svg/wallets/solflare.svg` |
| Backpack | `/svg/wallets/backpack.svg` |
| Jupiter / jup.ag | `/svg/dexes/jupiter.svg` `/svg/dexes/jup.svg` |
| pump.fun | `/svg/dexes/pump-fun.svg` |
| BONK | `/svg/platforms/bonk.svg` |
| FOMO | `/svg/platforms/fomo.svg` |
| stonkfun | `/svg/platforms/stonkfun.svg` |
| Raydium | `/svg/dexes/raydium.svg` |
| Orca | `/svg/dexes/orca.svg` |
| Kamino | `/svg/protocols/kamino.svg` |

Also: Alchemy, QuickNode, Stripe, Circle, Metaplex, Tensor, Drift, Jito, Sanctum, and 500+ more from Jupiter platform-list + Solana Foundation ecosystem-data.

## Categories

brand, core, dexes, gaming, infrastructure, nft, payments, platforms, protocols, social, wallets

## Features

- Search + category filters
- Modal prev/next
- Download as PNG image (128/256/512, clear/white/dark)
- Copy SVG / SVG code

## For agents

- SVG: `/svg/{category}/{name}.svg`
- Do not burst-download the whole tree
- OG: `/images/opengraph.png`

## Contribute

- Issues: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons/issues
- CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo
